definition: [ גָּלַשׁ ] verb sit, sit up , possibly also recline (compare Arabic sit up ; so Thes De and others (not Ew )) — only Qal Perfect (שֶׁ)גָָּֽלִשׁוּ Song 4:1 ; Song 6:5 שֶׁגָּלְשׁוּ מ(הר) גִּלְעָד of flocks of goats, in simile of a woman's hair; construction & sense rather awkward. גַּם see below גמם .
